### 🔵 Aspen HYSYS {#aspen-hysys}

### 🟢 DWSIM (Open Source) {#dwsim}

Complete unit operations simulated in open-source DWSIM v8. Free accessible software with full thermodynamic consistency.

::: {#dwsim-cases}
:::

### 🐍 Python & Thermodynamics {#python}

Numerical and analytical solvers in Python (NumPy, SciPy) for Rachford-Rice vapor fraction, isothermal flash curves, and ternary phase equilibria.

::: {#python-cases}
